Daily helpful news for returning guests
With that in mind
Travelers, please check your pet travel details before you head to the airport.

Aurelia Skyways is keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk ready for steady daily work, and we need everyone to stay alert on the basics. If you are bringing a pet, make sure the crate, papers, and feeding plan are all in order before you arrive. Small gaps can slow the handoff and add stress for your animal, so early review matters.

Our team treats each journey as a shared responsibility, and we want every trip to stay calm and clean from check-in through arrival. If Ben Garcia, Khalil Mori, or anyone else is traveling with Cleo or another companion animal, please keep leashes, carriers, and comfort items close at hand. If your pet seems uneasy, say so right away so we can help with the next step.

We are here for routine questions, last-minute updates, and practical support, and we will answer in a warm professional tone. If plans change, tell us as soon as you can so the desk can adjust the process without delay. For quick help and the latest guidance, go straight to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
